app.name: AquaPulse
app.offline: You are offline. Showing what was loaded before; changes wait until you are back online.

login.title: Log in
login.codeHelp: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for AquaPulse. Lost your phone? Type one of your recovery codes instead.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.help: Type your email. If it belongs to an account, we send a code to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If that account exists, an email with a code is on its way. It works for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: Your password is changed. Log in with the new one.

invite.title: Create your account
invite.help: Your building uses AquaPulse. Choose a password to see your water use and bills.

password.help: At least 10 characters. A few unrelated words is strong and easy to remember.

home.title: My home
home.noHome: You are not linked to a home yet. Ask your building owner to invite you.
home.deviceOffline: Your water meter has not been heard from since {{when}}. Readings may be old.
home.noDevice: No water meter is installed in your home yet.

quality.title: Water quality
quality.explain: pH says how acidic or alkaline water is, from 0 to 14; 7 is neutral. Drinking water should be between {{low}} and {{high}}. Below that it can taste sour and damage pipes; above that it can taste bitter and leave scale. AquaPulse alerts you and the owner if it stays outside for a few readings.

valve.title: Water supply
valve.confirmOff: Turn off the water in unit {{unit}}? Taps will stop until you turn it on again.
valve.confirmOn: Turn the water in unit {{unit}} back on?
valve.pending: Waiting for the valve to confirm…
valve.failed: The valve did not do it ({{reason}}).
valve.timeout: The valve did not answer in time. Check that the meter is online and try again.
valve.lockedHelp: Only the building owner can change it. Contact them if this is a mistake.
valve.offline: The meter is offline, so the valve cannot be switched now.

usage.title: My usage
usage.noAverage: Shown when at least 3 homes in the building are occupied (so nobody's own use can be worked out).
usage.notHere: You did not live here then.
usage.none: No water used in this period.

bills.title: My bills
bills.none: No bills yet. Bills are made after each month ends.
bills.payHelp: Stripe test mode: no real money. Use card 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future date and any CVC.
bills.paymentDone: Thank you. Your payment is being confirmed; this bill updates by itself in a moment.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.cleared: Problem gone since {{when}}; closes by itself 10 minutes later.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.changed: Password changed. Please log in again.
profile.logoutAllHelp: Ends every session on all your phones and browsers, including this one.
profile.twoFactorOn: On. Logging in needs your password and a code from your authenticator app.
profile.twoFactorOff: Off. Turn it on so a stolen password alone is not enough.
profile.scan: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (for example Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator; all free). Or type this key:
profile.enterCode: Type the 6-digit code the app shows
profile.recoveryHelp: Save these now (write them down or keep them in a password manager). Each works once if you lose your phone. They are not shown again.
profile.adminKeepsIt: System Admins must keep two-factor login on. You can still make new recovery codes.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.help: Alerts always show in the app. Here you choose which ones also come by email.
notifications.emailMin: Email me alerts from this level up
notifications.quietHelp: During these hours, non-critical emails wait until the end. Critical alerts (like unsafe water) always come at once.
notifications.push: Phone notifications come with the Android app.

owner.noBuilding: You have no building yet. A System Admin adds buildings for owners.
owner.vsLastMonth: {{change}} compared with the same days last month ({{litres}})
owner.noLastMonth: No readings for the same days last month
owner.insightsLater: Leak and usage predictions come in milestone M10. Nothing is shown here until they really work.
owner.empty: This building has no homes yet.
owner.noMeter: No meter yet. Register one on the Devices page.

lock.reasonHelp: At least 10 characters. Kept in the audit log.

people.title: Residents
people.hasContact: Someone else already gets the bills for this home. Change that first in the list above.
people.inviteHelp: They get an email with a link to choose a password. The link works for 7 days.
people.name: Full name

tank.title: Tank and pump
tank.none: This building has no tank yet.
tank.autoHelp: The pump starts below {{low}}% and stops at {{high}}%.
tank.manualHelp: You start and stop the pump. Safety stops still work.
tank.sumpEmpty: The sump is empty: the pump is kept off so it does not run dry.
tank.overflow: The tank is full: the pump was stopped to avoid overflow.
tank.energy: About {{kwh}} kWh in 7 days (pump of {{kw}} kW).
tank.settingsHelp: Changes go to the tank device. They show here once the device confirms.
tank.confirmManual: In manual mode the pump does not start by itself. Switch to manual?
tank.sent: Sent to the tank device. Waiting for it to confirm…

devices.title: Devices
devices.onceOnly: Copy this now. It is shown only once and cannot be shown again.

tariffs.title: Tariffs
tariffs.intro: Price per 1,000 litres in slabs. Saving makes a new version; bills already issued keep the old one.
tariffs.none: No tariff yet. Bills cannot be made until you add one.
tariffs.name: Name
tariffs.effectiveHelp: Must be after the last issued bill.
tariffs.chargesHelp: Tax: % of water plus extras. Extra %: % of water. Fixed: an amount per month.
tariffs.badRate: Slab {{n}}: type a rate of 0 or more.
tariffs.badEnd: Slab {{n}}: the end must be a whole number above {{from}}.
tariffs.chargeName: Every tax or charge needs a name.
tariffs.badCharge: {{name}}: type a value of 0 or more.
tariffs.previewWaiting: Fix the slabs above to see an example.

ownerBills.title: Bills
ownerBills.help: Drafts can be checked and made again. Once issued, a bill never changes (void it to replace it).
ownerBills.generated: {{created}} new, {{updated}} recalculated, {{kept}} already issued and kept, {{issued}} issued at once.
ownerBills.none: No bills for this month yet.
ownerBills.stripeRefund: For a card payment, also refund it in the Stripe dashboard (test mode).

settings.title: Building settings
settings.name: Building name
settings.timezoneHelp: Days and months are counted in this zone, for example Asia/Karachi.
settings.currencyHelp: Cannot change once the building has bills.
settings.dueDaysHelp: How many days after issue a bill is due (1 to 90).
settings.autoIssueHelp: Otherwise they wait as drafts for you to check.
settings.shutoff: Allow shutting off water for an overdue bill
settings.shutoffHelp: The resident gets a warning first, and 48 hours to pay.

alertRules.title: Alert rules
alertRules.intro: Switch each check on or off and set its numbers within safe limits. Everyone always sees alerts in the app.
alertRules.whoHelp: For each level, who is emailed about a new alert. People can mute alerts in their own settings too.

setup.title: Turn on two-factor login
setup.why: System Admins must use two-factor login (FR-70). The console opens as soon as it is on.
setup.step1: Install a free authenticator app on your phone (Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator).
setup.step2: Type your password below, then scan the QR code with the app.
setup.step3: Type the 6-digit code the app shows, then save your 10 recovery codes somewhere safe.

health.title: System health
health.notOk: Something is down. See the red lines below.
health.readingsSub: Meter and tank readings stored in the last 60 s
health.ofReceived: of {{count}} received since the ingestor started
health.noIngestor: The ingestor has not reported yet
health.emailsSub: Not delivered after 3 retries, last 7 days
health.noneRejected: None refused since the ingestor started.
health.noCheck: No check yet. The worker checks every day.
health.noBackup: Automatic backups are not set up yet, so there is no backup to show.

owners.title: Owners and buildings
owners.name: Full name
owners.disableHelp: A disabled owner is logged out everywhere at once and cannot log in. Their buildings and data stay.
owners.passwordHelp: Give it to the owner privately. They can change it in their profile.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.chainHelp: Each entry carries a hash of the one before it. Checking re-calculates every hash: one changed or removed entry breaks the chain.
audit.chainBroken: Broken at entry #{{id}} ({{when}}): an entry was changed or removed.
